concerns.text: Task T014 (sample size validation) is marked incomplete. FR-004 and SC-005 mandate a strict halt if <50 epochs/condition and a warning/flag if <100. Without this task, the pipeline cannot enforce the power requirement, violating the spec's mandatory acceptance criteria.

Task T017 (Save preprocessed epochs) is marked incomplete. This is the mandatory input artifact for T018 (Morlet decomposition) and the entire downstream pipeline. The spec requires a preprocessed data file containing ≥100 epochs; without T017, the deliverable falls short of FR-004.

Task T018 (Morlet wavelet decomposition) is marked incomplete. FR-005 explicitly requires computing Morlet wavelet time-frequency decomposition for the 8-30 Hz range. The absence of this task means the core feature extraction required by US-2 and FR-005 is missing.

Task T023 (Save feature matrix) is marked incomplete. FR-006 and US-2 require extracting mean power values into a matrix. Without saving this matrix, the downstream classification tasks (T025+) have no input, violating the data flow required by the spec.

Task T029 (FWE correction) is marked incomplete. FR-009 explicitly mandates applying family-wise error correction for multiple comparisons. The spec distinguishes this from permutation testing; omitting this task leaves a mandatory statistical validation step unimplemented.

Task T032 (Validate success criteria) is marked incomplete. SC-002 requires a mandatory pass/fail gating check against the benchmark. The task description mentions reporting 'benchmark_status: deferred' but does not explicitly implement the gating logic required by the spec's success criteria.
